text: People held in a California county jail while awaiting trial can still register and vote.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Voting Rights Restored
truthSource.oneLine: The Secretary of State lists people in a local detention facility who are awaiting trial among those who can register and vote. Only people serving a state or federal prison term for a felony cannot.

lesson.tip: California only bars people currently serving a state or federal prison term for a felony. Being held before trial, or serving a misdemeanor sentence, doesn’t take away the vote. When a post says “locked up,” ask which kind.
